text.tspan: Target missing? ServiceMonitor lacks the release label (or set *SelectorNilUsesHelmValues: false), port NAME mismatch, wrong selector.
metrics-server is only for kubectl top / HPA, not history. Watch cardinality: prometheus_tsdb_head_series.
